decision.question: What does Page.listing() return for a page.jsonl with no file lines?
options: null, so the caller falls back to directory.json
decision.why: before the backfill lands, a hand-made page.jsonl (title/place lines only) would otherwise read as an empty folder and hide real files; the fallback is always correct
decision.rule: brief#1 (a stale listing must never hide a real thing)

decision.question: Should listings stream live (ext/JSONL live.js) or be one fetch each?
options: stream every listing over the socket
one memoised fetch, Page.listing(url, fresh) refetches
decision.why: AI 2 reads ~100 task-folder listings; 100 socket subscriptions for file lists nobody watches is heavier than the problem. The brief marks live as optional. groups.js refetches the day listing when the socket says it changed
